# confidence

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:confidence`](gmeow-confidence.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/confidence>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/provenance`](../../slices/provenance.md)

**Property shape:** annotation property
